title: [MERGE 2026-09-01 after cache verification] update Claude Sonnet 5 pricing
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Sets Claude Sonnet 5 Bedrock input/output costs to the AWS standard rates effective 2026-09-01: $3/M input and $15/M output.
- Preserves the current $2.50/M cache-write and $0.20/M cache-read meters until AWS publishes authoritative post-promotion values.
- Leaves the canonical name, alias, route, paid-only policy, multiplier, capabilities, and no-fallback contract unchanged.
- Do not merge before 2026-09-01 or before rechecking AWS cache meters and completing direct-provider, local E2E, wallet, Tinybird, and catalog verification.
- Validation: 83 focused pricing/registry tests; Enter and Gen type checks; Biome.

Sources: https://aws.amazon.com/bedrock/pricing/ and https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/model-card-anthropic-claude-sonnet-5.html

gist.headline: Sonnet rates find their groove
gist.blurb: Claude Sonnet 5's Bedrock meter now follows AWS's September rate card. Polli checked the cache jars twice and left their existing labels alone.
gist.summary: Updated Claude Sonnet 5 Bedrock pricing to AWS's 2026-09-01 standard rates of $3/M input tokens and $15/M output tokens, while retaining $2.50/M cache-write and $0.20/M cache-read meters pending AWS's authoritative cache pricing.
gist.impact: Claude Sonnet 5 users now receive billing aligned with AWS's published input and output rates, with cache reads and writes continuing at their established meters.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a careful little bookkeeper in a cozy garden billing station, comparing a Bedrock-style cloud price card with token jars labeled input, output, cache write, and cache read. Input and output jars receive fresh labels while the two cache jars remain safely unchanged; small flowers and code-plants make the accounting feel like gentle maintenance rather than a sterile spreadsheet.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and a tiny accountant visor, carefully updating two glowing token jars beside a soft cloud-shaped Bedrock price card while two cache jars keep their existing labels; code-plants and small flowers grow around the desk, with lime green (#ecf874) prominent across the warm cream and lavender background. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, subtle CRT glow, pixel-font text reading "SONNET 5 RATES", nostalgic but beautiful and emotionally warm.
